statement: A company must have a registered office in Hong Kong to which all communications and notices may be addressed; the intended address stated in the incorporation form is the registered office from the date of incorporation, and a change of address must be notified to the Registrar in the specified form within 15 days after the change (Companies Ordinance section 658(1)-(3)).
caveat: Stating the address in the annual return does not satisfy the change-notice obligation (section 658(4)). The specified change-notice form is Form NR1.
